Article Name: Mechanical Properties and Stress–Strain Relationship of PVA-Fiber-Reinforced Engineered Geopolymer Composite
Author: Jian Zhou, Zhenjun Li, Xi Liu, Xinzhuo Yang, Jiaojiao Lv
Curing method: 24 h in mould under plastic film; demould; 24 h at 60 °C; then 20±2 °C, 95±2% RH until test
Conversions / notes: Mix CG. Table 4 kg/m3: FA 923.2, GGBS 230.8, quartz sand 403.9 (100–200 µm), water 86.5, alkali activator 432.7, PVA 26.0 kg/m3 (Kuraray REC15). Activator = Na2SiO3 (Ms 2.8) and NaOH flakes each dissolved to 40 wt% and blended to Ms 1.6; activator solution/B = 0.3750; WG/NaOH split and NaOH molarity not reported (columns blank). Quartz sand entered in SS/B.
